summary: Two exact admissible-tree witnesses contradict the grading and zero-sector assertions required for Lemma 3.5; the checked algebraic model identities are not refuted.

problems.title: Printed index set omits an admissible tree degree
problems.source_claim: Lemma 3.5 asserts that (A,PB,G) is a regularity structure with the page 18 index union and edge-sum degree.
assumptions: only nonzero edge ends at a leaf and is rightmost
include alpha_0=1 if time belongs to index union
problems.complete_check: Degree 1+1+(3/5-1)=8/5. Required integer multipliers for alpha_1 N and alpha_1 N-1 are 8/3 and 13/3; neither is integral. Time families add only integers.
problems.counterevidence: Reciprocal-integer common regularity avoids this witness; no such restriction appears in Lemma 3.5. Reading union as additive closure changes the printed definition. No dependence on a particular rough-path lift is needed for the algebraic grading check.
problems.impact: Invalid central grading prerequisite in Lemma 3.5 used by Theorem 3.8; not a refutation of Chen/model identities or all later Hopf-algebra results.

correction.statement: Replace A by the actual degree set of allowed trees. For finite positive alpha_i it is lower bounded and locally finite.
correction.proof: With k undecorated edges and m_i noise edges, m<=k+1 and degree=k-m+sum m_i alpha_i. Degree<=R bounds all m_i and k-m, so only finitely many degrees occur.
correction.limitation: Does not repair the zero-sector axiom or certify the whole regularity structure.

problems.title: Allowed resonant regularity gives a nontrivial zero sector
problems.source_claim: Definition 2.8 requires T0 isomorphic to R; Lemma 3.5 applies to the full declared PB space.
assumptions: formal PB tree vector space, no quotient relation
problems.complete_check: Degree 1+2(1/2-1)=0. This four-vertex basis tree is linearly independent of the one-vertex degree-zero unit; dimension(PB_0)>=2.
problems.counterevidence: Allowing a larger zero sector, imposing suitable nonresonance, or an appropriate invariant quotient/restriction could change the conclusion, but none is specified for Lemma 3.5.
problems.impact: Independent failure of the paper's own regularity-structure axiom in the same central construction, even after enlarging A.

correction.remaining: Supply and verify a compatible restricted space, nonresonance hypothesis or revised definition, including coaction compatibility.

checks_without_established_issue.result: Chen identity has matching endpoint order; time augmentation makes unit evaluation constant and condition (17) supports differentiation. No failure established in these checked steps.

limitations: Focused claim review, not exhaustive whole-paper verification
No analytic model estimates or SPDE solution theorem claimed
No full comparison with older arXiv mathematical text
